crossRefs.note: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year…

people.name: Shelumiel
people.line: Leader of the tribe of Simeon

people.name: Zurishaddai
people.line: Father of Shelumiel, leader of Simeon

translations.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
translations.bsb: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
translations.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
translations.asv: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs a year old: this was the oblation of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
